SELECT p.category, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) dist_lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_ids, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date), count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=6 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, cp.category, count(*) n, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS net_sales, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost),2) AS gm,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost)/SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS gm_pct
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=6 AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical')
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (SELECT store_id, ROUND(SUM(net_sales),2) ns FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26' GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (SELECT store_id, ROUND(SUM(net_sales),2) ns FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26' AND store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(m.store_id,c.store_id) sid, m.ns mine, c.ns ctl, round(m.ns-c.ns,2) diff FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.store_id=m.store_id
WHERE m.ns IS NULL OR c.ns IS NULL OR abs(m.ns-c.ns)>1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_week, cp.category, count(*) n,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_cost,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zero_cost,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos_net,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.standard_cost - f.quantity*p.standard_unit_cost)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cost_mismatch,
 round(sum(f.standard_cost)/sum(f.net_amount),4) cost_ratio,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vat_mismatch
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=6 AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') AND s.store_id<>999
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) dist_ret, count(DISTINCT r.sales_line_id) dist_sl,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.standard_cost_returned IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nullcost,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.store_key IS NULL OR r.product_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nullkeys

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, cp.category AS current_category, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS net_sales,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost)/SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS gm_pct,
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cp.subcategory='Outdoor Lighting' AND cp.category='Garden' THEN n.net_sales ELSE 0 END),2) AS ol_in_garden_current,
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cp.subcategory='Outdoor Lighting' THEN n.net_sales ELSE 0 END),2) AS ol_total,
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cp.subcategory='Outdoor Lighting' THEN n.net_sales-n.cost ELSE 0 END),2) AS ol_gm
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
